title: C: Mini Testing Framework
description: Build a simple testing framework with assertions and a test runner.

steps.title: Test Macros and Runner
steps.description: Define macros `ASSERT_EQ(a, b)` and `ASSERT_TRUE(c)` that print 'PASS' or 'FAIL' and increment global counts. Write a test runner that runs all registered tests. Create 3 tests: test_add, test_sub, test_fail.
hints: ASSERT_EQ: `if ((a) != (b)) { printf("FAIL\n"); fails++; } else printf("PASS\n"); passes++;`.

verification.failureMessage: Run all tests and print pass/fail counts
